purpose: Freeze one default-off source-exact C0/D active-clock-row candidate for the Phase80 direct/no-PDC GTSAM/Pose3 path. After this freeze, implementation of this contract is authorized; raw execution, truth read, MAT read, scoring, Kaggle access, and any default change remain unauthorized until separately frozen.

decision.candidate: select for implementation under this freeze and a separately authorized structural test
decision.basis: The existing per-epoch Doppler drift state is currently disconnected from scalar receiver-clock continuity; exact midpoint C0/D coupling can change P/D clock-versus-position allocation.
decision.evidence_limit: Plausibility is a source-level hypothesis. No accuracy result is claimed.

facts: c is a seven-element vector and d is a one-element state per epoch
PseudorangeFactor_XC receives c and DopplerFactor_VD receives d
ClockFactor_CCDD receives c1,c2,d1,d2 and raw dtgps
noise_clk is [sigma_motion_clk; zeros(6,1)] and noise_clkjump is [Inf; zeros(6,1)]
the factor is gated by dtgps < time_diff_th and the source phone exclusion list
time_diff_th is 1.5 seconds
sigma_motion_clk is 0.1 metres
the factor has Vector c1, Vector c2, scalar-vector d1 and d2 inputs
error is c2-c1 with only row 0 reduced by (d1[0]+d2[0])*dt/2
Hc1=-I and Hc2=+I; both drift Jacobians are zero except row 0=-dt/2
rows 1 through 6 are c2-c1 with no drift term and remain exact under the source zero-sigma rows
the Phase80 entrypoint selects GTSAM, Pose3 and IMU
direct observable quality is a separate opt-in P/D quality contract
direct quality conflicts with legacy upstream quality and requires no-bridge mode
the new clock flag is not present in this pinned implementation and is frozen here only
clock motion is enabled by default with clock_motion_sigma_m=300
corrected undifferenced Doppler is an independent opt-in path
fixed-lag smoothing is default off, so Phase80 uses the batch GTSAM path
per-epoch dopplerClockDriftKey states are initialized and used by receiver-only D rows
clockKey is scalar seconds and non-GPS ISBs are global/static scalars
the current clock row is BetweenFactor<double>(previous,current,0) over adjacent epochs
the current row has no dt, d1/d2 coupling, seven-vector, or 1.5-second edge gate
c is one per-epoch scalar base clock in seconds
i is one global inter-system-bias scalar per non-GPS constellation
d is an independent per-epoch receiver clock range-rate state

inherited_conflicts: the implicit PDC bridge path when --native-pdc-imu-tdcp is used without --native-pdc-imu-tdcp-no-bridge
candidate_contract.composition: Phase80 direct/no-PDC source-quality composition and sealed Phase78 route/settings composition remain unchanged

backend_scope.eigen_policy: The flag must be rejected outside this GTSAM/Pose3 path. Eigen exact parity is not claimed or implemented; it would require a separate freeze.

edge_gate.pixel5_result: Pixel5 is not source-excluded, so eligible non-jump edges are active
edge_gate.clock_jump: omit active C0 factor, equivalent to the source Inf-noise C0 row

factor.parity_scope: C0/D active-row parity, not full seven-vector parity
factor.state_and_factor_mapping: Use the existing scalar clockKey and existing per-epoch dopplerClockDriftKey; do not introduce a second clock row or a new PDC state.
factor.replacement_rule: Under the flag replace the current scalar clock BetweenFactor row; never add C0/D and the old scalar clock BetweenFactor for the same edge.
factor.static_states: Existing global/static ISB states and static receiver signal-bias states remain unchanged.
factor.seven_vector_disclaimer: The source C[1..6] exact continuity rows are not added by this C0/D-only candidate; no full taroz seven-component claim is permitted.

requirements.enabled: true only when the new flag is active; otherwise false
requirements.factor_count: count of inserted non-jump edges satisfying the edge gate
requirements.skip_accounting: invalid, gap, phone-exclusion, and clock-jump skips are mutually accounted for and never converted into a factor
requirements.dt_range: min/max finite positive dt observed for candidate edge accounting

focused_synthetic_tests_required_before_: residual and four Jacobian entries for non-unit dt with c in seconds and d in metres per second
clock-jump edge omits C0/D and reports a jump skip
dt <= 0 and non-finite dt report invalid skips
dt >= 1.5 seconds reports a gap skip; dt just below 1.5 is eligible
Pixel5 is eligible and each source-excluded phone is skipped
the old scalar clock BetweenFactor count is zero whenever the candidate is enabled
static ISB and signal-bias key spaces remain present and unchanged
structural_gates: source and inherited Phase80 hashes match the freeze
candidate is default-off and dependency/conflict checks are enforced
all required diagnostics are present and internally consistent
new C0/D factor count equals eligible non-jump edge count
legacy scalar clock BetweenFactor count is zero under the candidate
finite, converged, earth-valid keyed output with zero over-70-m/s transitions
two repeats per route are byte-identical
all eight planned runs complete without forbidden input or route selection

accuracy_after_structural_go_only.metric: exact integer (phone,UnixTimeMillis) matching; spherical Haversine per row; score=(P50+P95)/2

gates.logic: all gates are ANDed; any failure is no-go

accuracy_after_structural_go_only.policy: Only after a structural GO and a new accuracy freeze may one authorized development-train read per route occur; no validation, holdout, Kaggle, post-truth solver rerun, route tuning, or route-score selection.

forbidden_inputs: Phase82 candidate coordinates or any precomputed trajectory
